BUYING & PROJECT PLANNING

Project Documentation & Evidence Requests

Tell us the model, material, intended use and destination market. We will review which supporting documents are available and relevant to your project. This page does not certify the factory or the product range.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →

Review Documents by Project, Not by Badge

Request categoryWhat to check
Operator informationOperator, production site and project-relevant supply arrangements.
Material & component informationScope covering the body, decoration, lids and electrical components as applicable.
Available test reportsCheck issuer, report date, sample, methods and relevant use conditions.
Sample & inspection recordsRecords linked to the selected specification, artwork and review points.

These are document categories to ask about; not every model is promised every record. Certificate placeholder previews are not used as purchasing evidence.

A Three-Step Document Review

StepDetails
1. Define the requestModel, components, material, use and destination.
2. Check the scopeIssuer, operator, sample, test method, report date and applicability.
3. Match the orderCheck records against the actual material, decoration and supplied components.

Send a Specific Documentation Question

For example: for the selected FGB-006 body and light component, intended drink and cleaning method, what existing supporting records are available for a US-destination project? This is a question example, not a certification claim for the model.

Ask About Documents for a Model →

Make the Next Step Specific

Share the model, use, estimated quantity, artwork, destination and required arrival date. Identify any items you have not decided.

Prepare a Project Enquiry →
